description: Members PerkListSort patches or reads by name. Harmony and AccessTools bind by name at runtime, so a rename in a game update would otherwise be a silent no-op - the list would quietly go back to vanilla order with nothing in the log.

methods.name: Show
methods.why: postfixed; this is where the whole list is built, for both the perk and the talent cases

fields.name: _panels
fields.why: the live rows. Read rather than the root's children because freed rows stay parented and merely deactivated

fields.name: _abilityPanelsRoot
fields.why: not touched directly, but it is the parent whose sibling order the mod rewrites

fields.name: _abilityPanelsPool
fields.why: not touched; its Put-without-setParent behaviour is why leftovers stay under the root

fields.name: _perkId
fields.why: the sort key's source; read by FieldRefAccess

methods.name: Initialize
methods.why: not patched, but it is what proves the row's caption comes from perk.<id>.name

methods.name: ClearPerkGrades
methods.why: strips _basic/_advanced/_master/_legend so the localization key resolves, exactly as the panel does

methods.name: Get
methods.why: resolves the same display name the row shows, so the sort matches what the player reads. The second parameter is defaulted, so the call site passes one argument

methods.name: Put
methods.why: the optional setParent is why deactivated rows remain children of the list root
